original_query: select avg(ss_quantity) ,avg(ss_ext_sales_price) ,avg(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) ,sum(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) from store_sales    ,store    ,customer_demographics    ,household_demographics    ,customer_address    ,date_dim where s_store_sk = ss_store_sk and  ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 2001 and((ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'S' and cd_education_status = 'Secondary' and ss_sales_price between 100.00 and 150.00 and hd_dep_count = 3    )or    (ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'S' and cd_education_status = 'Secondary' and ss_sales_price between 50.00 and 100.00 and hd_dep_count = 1    ) or    (ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'S' and cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' and ss_sales_price between 150.00 and 200.00 and hd_dep_count = 1    )) and((ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('MS', 'NY', 'VA') and ss_net_profit between 100 and 200    ) or    (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('MS', 'TN', 'TX') and ss_net_profit between 150 and 300    ) or    (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('NC', 'NM', 'OK') and ss_net_profit between 50 and 250    )) ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT AVG(ss.ss_quantity),
       AVG(ss.ss_ext_sales_price),
       AVG(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost),
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
JOIN customer_address ca ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'S'
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Secondary', '2 yr Degree')
  AND hd.hd_dep_count IN (1, 3)
  AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
  AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
  AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
  AND ca.ca_state IN ('MS','NY','VA','TN','TX','NC','NM','OK')
  AND (
        (cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
         AND (
              (hd.hd_dep_count = 3 AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
           OR (hd.hd_dep_count = 1 AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
         ))
     OR (cd.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree'
         AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1
         AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
      )
  AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('MS','NY','VA') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('MS','TN','TX') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
     OR (ca.ca_state IN ('NC','NM','OK') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      );

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Factored common join predicates (ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk, cd_demo_sk=ss_cdemo_sk) and cd_marital_status='S' out of the repeated OR branches; factored ca_country='United States' and ss_addr_sk=ca_address_sk out of the second OR group.
Converted implicit comma joins to explicit ANSI JOINs with ON clauses for clearer join semantics and better optimizer handling.

Added logically implied pushdown filters: cd_education_status IN ('Secondary','2 yr Degree'), hd_dep_count IN (1,3), ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200 (union of price ranges), ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300 (union of profit ranges), and ca_state IN (union of all 8 states) so the optimizer can reduce large tables before evaluating complex OR filters.
Consolidated overlapping range constants; the branch-specific ranges are retained while the broad implied ranges (price [50,200], profit [50,300]) enable earlier base-table filtering.

Kept the small dimension joins (store, date_dim) as inner joins to preserve exact equivalence (inner joins exclude unmatched/null FK rows); avoided CTEs since no redundant subquery calculation exists and CTEs may inhibit predicate pushdown.
